summary: Tested Layout Configurator bug fixes: 1) Room addition via dialog, 2) Element addition from library, 3) 90° rotation dimension label swap, 4) Dimension line dragging. Features 1-3 work correctly. Feature 4 (dimension line dragging) requires manual verification - the code fix appears correct but automated testing couldn't definitively confirm drag behavior.

issues: Console shows repeated 'alphabetical' is not valid CanvasTextBaseline enum - fabric.js compatibility warning (non-blocking)

features_tested.details: Clicking 'Комната' opens dialog with outer dimensions (200x150cm), 4 wall thickness fields (default 4.4cm each), auto-calculated inner dimensions. Room appears on canvas with dimension labels.
Clicking Печь (heater) in library panel adds element to canvas. Toast shows 'Добавлен: печь'. Element is selected with full properties panel showing type, dimensions, rotation controls.
Rotation button works - Поворот changes from 0° to 90°. Code review confirms isRotated90 logic at lines 1708-1718 correctly swaps width/height for dimension labels when angle is 45-135° or 225-315°.

Code at lines 920-956 sets isDimensionLine objects as selectable/evented when Select tool is active. The fix preserves dimension line interactivity. Automated playwright testing attempted drag but couldn't definitively confirm success - Properties panel showed 'Выберите элемент' after drag attempts. Recommend manual testing by user.

code_review_findings.lines_920_956_tool_switching: Logic correctly excludes isDimensionLine objects from being disabled when drawing tools are active. When Select tool is active, dimension lines are made selectable (lines 944-953).
code_review_findings.lines_1708_1718_rotation_swap: isRotated90 calculation correctly detects 90° or 270° rotation and swaps topDimensionCm/leftDimensionCm values accordingly.

action_items: Manual verification recommended: Test dimension line (red dashed line with arrows) dragging by clicking directly on the line and attempting to drag
Minor: Consider suppressing fabric.js 'alphabetical' textBaseline console warnings
critical_code_review_comments: The dimension line dragging fix at lines 920-956 looks correct - it preserves isDimensionLine interactivity
The rotation label swap fix at lines 1708-1718 looks correct - uses isRotated90 boolean to swap dimensions
context_for_next_testing_agent: Layout Configurator testing completed. Room addition, element addition, and rotation label swap all work. Dimension line dragging code fix appears correct but needs manual verification - user should try clicking on the red dashed dimension lines (showing distances to walls) and dragging them when Select tool is active. Path: Login -> Panel administracyjny -> Планировки tab.

dimension_lines_not_dragging.root_cause: When tool mode changed, all objects were being set to non-selectable, including dimension lines that should remain interactive
dimension_lines_not_dragging.fix_applied: Lines 929 and 946 now check for isDimensionLine property and preserve interactivity for these objects
dimension_lines_not_dragging.verification: Code fix looks correct. Automated test couldn't click precisely on thin dimension lines.

rotation_labels_not_swapping.root_cause: Dimension labels were using original width/height without considering object rotation angle
rotation_labels_not_swapping.fix_applied: Lines 1708-1718 calculate isRotated90 boolean and swap dimensions accordingly
rotation_labels_not_swapping.verification: Code fix is correct. When angle is 45-135° or 225-315°, width/height labels are swapped.
